title: Whole Cell Lipidome Extraction with MBTE
author: Clare Benson

steps.title: Cell Preparation and Growth
steps.instruction: Prepare cell lines and grow to confluence.

substeps.instruction: Perform mycoplasma test (Biovision) on all cell lines according to manufacturer's instructions.
Plate 4×10^5 cells/well in a 6 well plate (4 wells per condition as technical replicates).
Grow cells for 48 h until 80% confluence is reached.

steps.title: Cell Harvesting and Lysate Preparation
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and homogenize the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells on ice and wash each well twice with cold Dulbecco’s PBS (DPBS).
Add 300 µL of freshly prepared 155 mM ammonium bicarbonate (prepared by dissolving 0.61 g in 50 ml DPBS and briefly sonicating).
Scrape cells from the plate surface using a cell scraper and transfer the lysate to a 1.5 mL tube.
Homogenize each sample by passing it 10 times through a 25 G needle attached to a sterile syringe.

steps.title: Protein Quantification and Storage
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration and store remaining lysate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of each lysate to a 1.5 mL tube for protein concentration determination using the Pierce™ BCA Protein Assay Kit (Thermo Scientific) per manufacturer's instructions.
Snap-freeze the remaining cell lysate in liquid nitrogen and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Extraction Tube Preparation
steps.instruction: Clean and label glass tubes for lipid extraction.

substeps.instruction: Clean two glass Wheaton tubes (Fisher Scientific Ltd) per sample by adding 400 µL of LC-MS grade methanol, vortexing briefly, and draining.
Use Wheaton tube caps with Teflon film (VWR International).
Label tubes as A and B for every sample and control, writing the sample name on two sides of the glass tube (top and bottom on opposite sides).

steps.title: Sample Aliquoting and Standardization
steps.instruction: Prepare sample aliquots and add internal standards.

substeps.instruction: Add a sample volume equivalent to 60 µg of protein to tube A and top up with 155 mM ammonium bicarbonate to a final volume of 200 µL.
Prepare blank extractions by adding 200 µL of 155 mM ammonium bicarbonate to two extra tubes.
Add 10 µL of SPLASH™ LIPIDOMIX™ Mass Spec Standard (Avanti Research) to each sample.

steps.title: Initial Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first phase of lipid extraction using methanol and MTBE.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL methanol to the 200 µL sample aliquot (using a P1000 pipette tip twice, 750 µL each).
Vortex each sample briefly (~4 seconds).
Clean the external lower part of a glass pipette with HPLC-grade MTBE (Merck) using a waste MTBE glass container.
Add 5 mL of MTBE to each sample using the cleaned glass pipette.
Incubate for 1 h at RT on a digital orbital shaker at 200 rpm in a slanting position.

steps.title: Phase Separation and First Collection
steps.instruction: Separate phases and collect the organic layer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.25 mL of MS-grade water to each sample to generate two-phase separation.
Incubate at RT for 10 min, then centrifuge at 1,000 × g at 4°C for 10 min.
Collect the upper organic phase using a glass Pasteur pipette and transfer it to the corresponding tube B.

steps.title: Second Lipid Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second extraction on the remaining lower phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of MTBE/methanol/water (10:3:2.5, v/v/v) to the lower phase in tube A using a glass Pasteur pipette.
Incubate at RT for 10 min, then centrifuge at 1,000 × g at 4°C for 10 min.
Collect the upper organic phase using a glass Pasteur pipette and transfer it to tube B.

steps.title: Evaporation and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry the samples and store them.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate the solvent from the upper phase in tubes B using a nitrogen stream.
Store evaporated samples at -20 °C.

steps.title: Resuspension and Final Preparation
steps.instruction: Resuspend lipids in loading buffer and transfer to HPLC vials.

substeps.instruction: Immediately prior to running, add 100 µl of loading buffer (Isopropanol: Acetonitrile: Water at 2:1:1 ratio) to each dried sample and vortex for 30 seconds.
Transfer the resuspended sample to a clean 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge at 13,000 × g at 4 °C for 3 minutes.
Transfer 90 µl of each sample to HPLC vials with glass inserts.
Label each tube with the extraction date and sample name.
